verdict.rationale: An official CLI exists. It can run local models offline without an account, and the hosted endpoint is OpenAI-compatible, so scripts can call it with standard clients. Together these suggest non-interactive automation is possible. However, Cloud authentication is documented as a browser sign-in flow, which works against headless or CI use, and no CI or headless guidance is documented. Missing for 10: documented headless/CI mode, non-interactive auth (API key or token for CI), CI examples or exit-code/scripting docs, independent corroboration of automated use.
